prose.gv18: The GV18 is a 400W brushless cordless stick vacuum delivering 30kPa of suction in a lightweight body, with a removable 2200mAh battery that runs 20–65 minutes per charge. It handles wet and dry pick-up with a 1.2L dust cup and HEPA filtration, runs at ≤65dB, and features a smart touch LED display. Available as OEM/ODM with custom colour and plug type for your market. Certification documents are on file and available on request.
prose.gt20: The GT20 is a 3-in-1 robot vacuum and mop with LDS SLAM navigation, 5000Pa suction and 120–150 minutes of runtime. It sweeps and mops with a 220ml dustbin and 230ml water tank, supports App control (Tuya) and voice control (Alexa / Google Assistant), and offers smart mapping, no-go zones and virtual walls, obstacle avoidance and auto recharge. OEM/ODM customisation available for colour, voltage and plug type. Certification documents on file.
prose.ymc6628: The YMC6628 is a cordless portable tire inflator with a 150PSI / 10.3Bar maximum pressure, an 11.1V lithium-polymer battery (2000mAh × 3) and a digital pressure gauge that stops automatically at your target value. It doubles as a power bank with emergency LED light and pressure monitoring, charges in 2–3 hours and runs about 25 minutes per charge. CE certified, suitable for compact cars and motorcycles, with OEM/ODM colour customisation available.
